title: Website overview

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Coordinate expressive entry imagery with orderly navigation because visitors must move from interest to finding a performance.
strategic_value: A branded hero and clear program cards can connect the Symphony’s cultural voice to practical discovery.
demonstration: A website recording shows a Throughline video hero, upcoming-show cards, collaborative portraits and a Currents section while the page scrolls.
practical_value: Compare expressive headings with the quieter grid and metadata used for browsing.

content_islands.name: Hero
content_islands.spec: Preserve the moving hero imagery, large Throughline title and navigation.

content_islands.name: Program grid
content_islands.spec: Keep the repeated upcoming-show cards and their smaller descriptions.

content_islands.name: Editorial sections
content_islands.spec: Retain the collaborator field and Currents content farther down the page.
